clue.text: Celebrate lavishly on a launch

definitions.meaning: to spend freely and go all out on a party or treat
literally shoving a boat off from the shore, as when a launch is set afloat

explanation.surface: A ship's launch is marked with a lavish party.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to spend extravagantly on festivities, and it also literally describes shoving a vessel off into the water.

clue.text: German man in group is visibly embarrassed

indicators.note: the man's name sits inside the word for a group

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people
Carl is a common German man's name

explanation.surface: A German man in a group is plainly red-faced with embarrassment.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone flushed with embarrassment turns red in the face, the vivid colour of a blush.

clue.text: Bound to be neck and neck on the day

definitions.text: neck and neck on the day
definitions.meaning: level in a contest when it finishes, with no winner

explanation.definitionFit: Bound means fastened with string or rope, and a level contest with equal scores at the end is a draw.

clue.text: Height to which RC priest may aspire?

definitions.meaning: a high place or raised ground

definitions.text: to which RC priest may aspire?
definitions.meaning: the style His ... belongs to a Roman Catholic cardinal, a rank a priest might hope to reach

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a hill or elevation, and is also the title of a cardinal in the Roman Catholic Church.

clue.text: Established writer immersed in a dictionary

indicators.note: the writer is sunk inside the dictionary's letters

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a pen is something one writes with

explanation.surface: An established author is buried deep in a dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: To establish a shop or business is to start it up or set it going for the first time.

clue.text: Current crossing drivers find taxing

parts.note: a span over a flowing river where motorists must pay a charge, so it taxes them in money rather than effort

explanation.definitionFit: A span over water where motorists pay a fee to cross is literally taxing on them.

clue.text: Where branching out may get one in difficulties

definitions.text: Where branching out may get one
definitions.meaning: climbing out along the boughs puts one high in the branches of a tree
an idiom for being stuck in a fix

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally places someone high among boughs, and idiomatically means stuck in a predicament.

clue.text: Met harassed, distraught education chiefs

indicators.note: being upset and in turmoil, the letters of these two words are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: School principals are upset and harried by the Metropolitan Police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Met' looks like the London police force, but it is simply three letters of fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The heads of schools are the chief figures in charge of pupils' learning.

clue.text: Menial job on the tennis court

parts.note: base can mean low or menial
a line of work is one's job

explanation.surface: Someone takes a lowly job working at a tennis club.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: it names where the thing is, the back line at each end of a tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: The marking at the back of each end of a court in tennis is where servers stand.

clue.text: Let trainee rest

parts.note: L stands for learner, as on British learner-driver plates
ease means rest or relaxation

explanation.surface: Allow a trainee to have a break.
explanation.definitionFit: To let a property is to rent it out under a contract to a tenant.

clue.text: Don't go and make presentation to a young lady

definitions.meaning: to decline to attend or skip something

definitions.text: make presentation to a young lady
definitions.meaning: literally to hand something over to an unmarried girl, addressed as Miss

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to skip or avoid something; read literally, it is handing a gift to an unmarried girl.

clue.text: Problems afflicting ailing Pole

parts.note: ill means ailing or unwell
S is the south pole

explanation.surface: Troubles are besetting a sick Polish man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' suggests a person from Poland; it is a magnetic pole, south.
explanation.definitionFit: Troubles and misfortunes are evils that beset someone.

clue.text: Recalled seeing MP in woodwind section

indicators.note: the MP goes inside the woodwind word

parts.note: a reed is the vibrating part of a woodwind instrument, and the woodwind are often called the reeds
an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone remembers seeing a politician among the orchestra's woodwind players.
explanation.definitionFit: Called to mind again, brought back from memory.

clue.text: Venue where people jockey for position

definitions.text: Venue where people jockey for position

parts.words: Venue where people jockey for position
parts.note: jostling for advantage is described by a racing word, and the place where riders literally race for position is a horse-racing track

explanation.definitionFit: A track for horse racing is where riders compete for the best place.

clue.text: Admission to cause delight

definitions.meaning: a way in or the right to come in
to enchant or put into a trance of pleasure, stressed on the second syllable

explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a way in or right to come in; the verb, stressed differently, means to enchant.

clue.text: Came in order to get pictures

indicators.note: the letters are to be put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone came in so as to collect some photographs.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the pictures is an old-fashioned way of saying going to see a film at the movie theatre.

clue.text: Average prison sentence for the moment

parts.note: the mean is an average
doing time is serving a prison sentence

explanation.surface: An average jail term is handed down for now.
explanation.definitionFit: The interval in between, as in 'in the interim', is the stretch of time until something else happens.

clue.text: Watch one's heart

definitions.meaning: slang for a wristwatch, from its ticking
slang for the heart, which beats like a clock

explanation.definitionFit: Both a timepiece and the organ pumping blood are slangily named for the regular beating noise they make.

clue.text: About to take one back to the reservoir

parts.note: C is circa, about
I is the Roman numeral one
the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone is about to take a person back to the reservoir.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like a direction, but it is the rear of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A tank storing water is a small-scale reservoir.

clue.text: Army man dispatched without some change of gear

indicators.note: here meaning outside, so the sent letters wrap round the others

parts.note: sent means dispatched

indicators.note: the letters of gear are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A soldier is sent off without a change of kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense outside, not lacking: the dispatched word wraps round the rearranged gear, which 'some change of' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-commissioned officer rank in the army, above corporal.

clue.text: Stop after snake appears, it was dumped on the road

definitions.text: it was dumped on the road

indicators.note: the word for stop comes after the snake word

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
halt means stop

explanation.surface: A driver stops when a snake appears on the road surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The black tarry surfacing material is laid down on roads by the truckload.

clue.text: Poor artist in acute difficulty

indicators.note: the letters of the word are in a poor state, so rearranged

explanation.surface: A struggling painter is in dire trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in dire straits means being in serious trouble; a strait is a tight predicament.

clue.text: Calamity ensues when Mark is given great wealth

parts.note: taken as written
a fortune is great wealth

explanation.surface: Disaster follows when Mark comes into a lot of money.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad luck or a disaster is a stroke of ill fate.

clue.text: A crystal box

definitions.meaning: a crystalline mineral that splits easily, such as feldspar
to box is to ..., sparring in the ring

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a glassy crystalline mineral, and the verb means to box in practice.

clue.text: Get away from Soho

indicators.note: the answer is made from the letters of the place name, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is told to leave Soho, the London district.
explanation.walkthrough: Soho is an entertainment district in central London.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation used to drive off an animal or person, meaning go away.

clue.text: Trim man accommodated in South Africa by Rex

indicators.note: the man is housed inside the country's letters

parts.note: he is a man
R is the abbreviation for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A slim man is put up in South Africa by a king.
explanation.definitionFit: To clip or cut hair or wool short, as when sheep are sheared.

clue.text: Drug-user seen by a top detective

parts.note: the CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
the head is the top

explanation.surface: A drug addict is spotted by a senior police detective.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a habitual taker of LSD, the drug once called acid.

clue.text: Other daughter initially not cured by this treatment

definitions.text: Other daughter initially not cured by this treatment

indicators.note: the letters undergo treatment, being worked into a new arrangement
only the opening letter of daughter is used

explanation.surface: A second daughter has not been healed by this course of therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a patient still not cured is in a doctor's care.
explanation.definitionFit: Being treated by a physician for an illness, still receiving medical care.
